The audience always enjoys the glamorous performance on stage, their tragic past, has never been mentioned by anyone.

notes.title: Comicalize Announcement 🎪
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42115558/8e5babcd13b0ea05522d999c1f5f0318264d4690.png[/img]

Long time no see, here's Team Shadow.
The past story of the two chiefs, will be officially released as a free comic next month!

This comic will replenish the story of Edrona and Vasilia before they entered the circus.

Edrona and Vasilia are not biological sisters, but they are inseparable because of their strong relationship.
How did the "calm and gentle sister" and the "irascible sister" meet?

-

"No matter when and what happens, you are always my sister."

-
[b]
See you all in September! [/b]
[u]*We are now planning a game update with Japanese version and new map these months, for more details and updates please follow our Twitter.[/u]
